_provenance.source: Samsung Electro-Mechanics product database (product.samsungsem.com/mlcc/bSearch.do), full CL-series dump
_provenance.filter: CL series only (not CLR/CLL), Mass Production, listed, and the tolerance this library pairs with each dielectric (C0G +/-5%, X7R/X5R +/-10%)
_provenance.meaning: key is '<EIA size>|<rated volts>|<dielectric>|<farads>'; value is a real Samsung part number for that exact combination. Samsung's own thickness code is not derivable from those four fields, which is why this table exists instead of a rule.
